findings.title: Young man killed, others wounded by occupation forces' gunfire central Gaza Strip
findings.location: Al-Ja'farawi area, east of Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Palestinian civilians: one young man reportedly killed and several others wounded by Israeli live fire; WAFA did not provide verified identities or precise injury count.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: resulting in the death of one young man and injuries to several others.
findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency report citing local sources

discovery_context.within_observation_window: WAFA Arabic first published at 11:50 local Palestine time; English at 12:04, after previous watch's latest index at 11:20.
discovery_context.corroboration: Safa local correspondent on 17 November additionally named the reported deceased as Ayoub Talat Ayoub, 21, and reported three other injuries, including one child; not independently hospital-verified.
discovery_context.distinct_from: 09:31 local WAFA report of Deir al-Balah/al-Maghazi vehicle incursion and residential demolitions, captured in preceding watch; this concerns direct reported casualties in al-Ja'farawi.

findings.affected_population_or_system: One Palestinian reportedly critically injured by an Israeli drone strike; identity and hospital status unverified.

discovery_context.within_observation_window: Late-recalled distinct civilian injury reported in a dated local-field news account discovered in this execution; source's displayed 07:10 Palestine time precedes observation window and any later modification time is unknown.
discovery_context.distinct_from: Al-Ja'farawi gunshot casualties east of Deir al-Balah: different location and drone-strike mechanism; do not merge or imply independently confirmed.

findings.title: UN warns against Israeli attacks on residential areas and near aid convoys in Gaza
findings.publisher: WAFA, quoting UN Deputy Spokesperson Farhan Haq and OCHA officials
findings.affected_population_or_system: UN humanitarian personnel and fuel convoy exposed to reported nearby airstrike; injuries, convoy damage, fuel loss or interruption were not reported.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Haq stated that on Sunday, Israel carried out an airstrike on a site very close to a UN fuel convoy in Rafah.
findings.source_type: Established public news agency quoting named UN spokesperson's 16 November briefing; primary UN transcript not accessed

discovery_context.within_observation_window: Late-recalled 15 November incident relayed in UN briefing 16 November, first found here in WAFA's new 17 November 12:07 Arabic / 12:19 English publication.
discovery_context.corroboration: WAFA identifies Deputy UN spokesperson Farhan Haq as reporting the account and quoting OCHA concerns, but direct UN briefing source could not be retrieved within bounds.
discovery_context.distinct_from: General winter supply warnings and 16 November OCHA access map; this is a specified near-convoy security incident, not proof of changed border access or convoy cargo loss.
